prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: final macOS application icon for "Pyramid Fuzz", a boutique guitar fuzz audio app.
Input image: the supplied pedal panel is a STYLE AND PALETTE REFERENCE ONLY. Create a new icon, not a crop or a mockup.
Primary request: a polished, distinctive, immediately recognizable app icon that belongs to this existing black-and-antique-gold Egyptian pedal identity.
Composition: one large bold gold pyramid / triangular relief emblem with a single stylized eye inset near its upper center. A few short broad sun rays above the apex may echo the reference. Center the emblem on a deep obsidian rounded-square tile with a restrained antique-gold inner rim. The pyramid must fill most of the tile and read clearly at 32 pixels; keep its silhouette and the eye bold. Strong negative space, limited details.
Style: sophisticated engraved metal / enamel badge, premium illustrated boutique audio hardware; subtle gold bevels and matte black texture, decisive thick shapes, warm gold and faint copper shading. Refined and ominous rather than cartoonish. Depth without visual clutter.
Output: single square 1024x1024 icon, tile centered with roughly 7 percent breathing space around it, rounded corners and truly transparent pixels outside the tile. Front-on artwork, not a photographed object; no perspective or ground shadow.
Constraints: no words, letters, numbers, watermark, surrounding scene, app-window mockup, headphones, guitar, tiny hieroglyphs, filigree, detailed desert landscape, or additional badges. Do not include the reference image's border ornaments or sphinx. Preserve the reference's black/gold identity while simplifying it heavily for a small application icon.
build_packaging: JUCE ICON_BIG generates 1024px and 512px Icon.icns entries
